name: Neural Reflectance Fields
definition: The first extension of NeRF to achieve relighting, representing the scene as a volume density field, surface normals, and Bidirectional Reflectance Distribution Functions (BRDFs) field.
summary: Neural Reflectance Fields extends NeRF by modeling density, normals, and BRDFs to enable relighting under arbitrary lighting, unlike standard NeRF which only captures emitted radiance.
